mainEntity.name: How long are SHRED classes typically?

acceptedAnswer.text: SHRED classes at Cave Training typically run for 45 to 60 minutes. This duration includes a warm-up period at the beginning and a cool-down session at the end. The workout itself is structured to provide an effective, intense session within this timeframe, allowing participants to achieve a comprehensive workout efficiently. The specific timing can vary slightly depending on the day's programming.
